_notes: Answer key written by hand, before Tanya is run against it, per the watch-outs' 'fix the ground truth before you run anything.' 20 scored questions (11 cross-division, 9 single-division) plus 3 out-of-scope questions (one per division) to check abstention. 'expected_divisions' lists every division whose documents must be retrieved for a FULLY correct, grounded answer -- this is what the context-recall metric in Section 7 of the problem statement is scored against. 'source_doc_ids' point at data_dictionary.md ids.

questions.question: What packaging change forced F&B to order new CNC tooling, and what was delivered?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Aurora Beverages' bottle neck/cap diameter changed 28mm->26mm (thread pitch change); CNC delivered a new machined capping-head assembly (CNC-WO-0442) within a 48-hour expedited turnaround.

questions.question: Was the CNC tooling for the Aurora packaging change installed immediately, and on which asset?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Delivered 2026-05-16; installed same day on capping head asset FL2-CAP-01 and calibrated/tested against QC-FNB-002.

questions.question: How long did it take from packaging-change request to tooling delivery, and what surcharge applies to that kind of expedite?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Requested 2026-05-14, delivered 2026-05-16 (48-hour expedited window); CNC's material procurement policy notes a 30% surcharge for expedited orders under 10 units.

questions.question: Why was external CNC client order C-4471 delayed, and by how many days?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Delayed 4 business days because CNC reallocated ~22 machine-hours to expedite F&B's CNC-WO-0458 (second capping head) ahead of the Aurora Beverages rush order; the external client accepted the new date without penalty.

questions.question: What second capping head installation followed CNC's June 2026 capacity reprioritisation, and when was it installed?
questions.expected_answer_summary: FL2-CAP-02 installed 2026-06-10, using parts from CNC-WO-0458 delivered 2026-06-08 -- six days ahead of the requested date.

questions.question: Which specific external CNC order was pushed back due to the F&B rush order, and what product does it involve?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Order #C-4471, precision bracket components for a non-TGMOK external client, pushed back 4 business days.

questions.question: What did CNC Production Planning recommend to avoid repeat impact on external clients from future F&B rush orders?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Recommended F&B Client Services flag rush-order possibilities at contract signing rather than at order placement -- this is the second FY2026 instance of a rush order forcing mid-cycle reprioritisation.

questions.question: How did F&B fund its second capping head, and who has authority over facilities of that size?
questions.expected_answer_summary: $180,000 intercompany working-capital facility from the Jewellery division, 18-month repayment at the Group internal transfer rate; approved at divisional level since it is below the $250,000 Group CFO sign-off threshold.

questions.question: What intercompany facility supports CNC's raw-material buffer, and what is the buffer for?
questions.expected_answer_summary: A $45,000 facility from the Jewellery division (12-month repayment) funds CNC's rolling 2-week buffer of MS-07 tool steel, kept specifically to absorb expedited internal work orders like F&B's.

questions.question: What must happen to a piece that fails gold purity certification?
questions.expected_answer_summary: It is quarantined and routed back to Production for investigation; it may not be re-tested and released without a documented cause.

questions.question: Which division manufactures the stamping die for a custom jewellery order, and how is that machining cost billed?
questions.expected_answer_summary: CNC machines the die (billed to the client as a tooling line item, e.g. $850 in quote JWL-Q-3391); CNC's procurement policy bills intercompany material/tooling work at cost plus a 5% handling fee.

questions.question: What component is CNC currently machining for the Jewellery division, and what is it for?
questions.expected_answer_summary: CNC-WO-0470, a custom stamping die, due 2026-07-10 -- jewellery's pricing policy notes custom dies are sourced from CNC rather than an external toolmaker for tooling charges under $10,000.

questions.question: What must happen if a hygiene non-conformance is found, and does a rush order change this?
questions.expected_answer_summary: The affected line halts until QA signs off on corrective action; a rush order does not exempt a line from a required CIP cycle or swab test.

questions.question: What concentration risk did Group Treasury flag in the F&B Q3 financial summary?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Three divisions with materially different cash-flow cycles relying on one internal lending facility (the Jewellery-division-funded facility) is a concentration risk noted in the Q3 review minutes.

questions.question: Does an urgent internal tooling request waive CNC's lockout-tagout requirement?
questions.expected_answer_summary: No -- lockout-tagout (LOTO-01) applies before any unscheduled calibration or maintenance regardless of how urgent the requesting work order is.

questions.question: What tolerance was required for work order CNC-WO-0442, and was a calibration check done before machining began?
questions.expected_answer_summary: ±0.02mm thread-pitch tolerance; an unscheduled calibration check on CNC Mill 3 was completed 2026-05-15, before machining began, passing within tolerance.

questions.question: How long is a Jewellery division client quote valid, and why is the window that short?
questions.expected_answer_summary: 5 business days, because quotes are priced off the daily LBMA AM gold fix, which is volatile day to day.

questions.question: What custody control applies to accessing raw gold stock in the vault?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Dual custody -- two authorised staff are required to open the vault.

questions.question: Is a custom jewellery piece eligible for return, and where is that disclosed to the client?
questions.expected_answer_summary: No -- custom pieces are final sale; this is disclosed in writing to the client at the quotation stage, as shown in quote JWL-Q-3391 (acknowledged 2026-06-25).

questions.question: What six checks must pass before an F&B pilot run is cleared for full-line rollout?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Fill volume ±1.5%, cap torque 8-12 in-lb, 24-hour seal integrity test (zero leaks), label alignment within 2mm, carton drop test with no breakage, and correct/legible batch code and best-before date.

questions.question: What is F&B's annual revenue target for FY2027?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Not covered -- only Q3 FY2026 actuals and Q4 guidance assumptions exist; no FY2027 target is stated anywhere in the corpus. Tanya should abstain or say the documents do not contain this, not invent a number.

questions.question: Does the CNC division hold ISO 9001 certification?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Not mentioned anywhere in the corpus. Tanya should abstain rather than infer certification from the calibration/safety SOPs present.

questions.question: What resale value guarantee does the Jewellery division offer on pieces after 5 years?
questions.expected_answer_summary: Not covered -- the returns policy only addresses 14-day refund / 30-day exchange / 60-day resizing windows, nothing about a multi-year resale guarantee. Tanya should abstain.
